name: daily-control
description: SYNTHETIC. Quillmark Trust & Savings (fictional): daily interest accrual with a running general-ledger control total.

javaConversion.origin: hand-written naive fixture, not model output

layoutsNote: Hand-written from copybooks/DAYREC.cpy and copybooks/CTLREC.cpy until the analyzer emits layouts[].

traps.behaviour: COMPUTE ROUNDED is half away from zero, including negative interest (-0.005 -> -0.01).
The control total adds each account's rounded interest; summing unrounded amounts and rounding once gives a different total.
No ON SIZE ERROR: WS-INTEREST S9(7)V99 drops high-order digits on overflow, and the wrapped amount is what enters the control total.
The control total is DISPLAYed through the edited picture -(11)9.99 (floating minus, leading spaces), and PIC 9(7) COMP counters print 10 digits.

fixtureCases.why: -0.005 rounds away from zero to -0.01; the pair cancels in the control total
0.025 gives 0.03 per record; summing unrounded amounts gives a control total 0.01 lower
0.000274 rounds to zero: flagged Z and counted as lost
interest overflows S9(7)V99; the wrapped amount goes into the control total
